theme_and_archetype.description: Authority, Clarity, Truth. A function-first, data-heavy dashboard for BPO QA and coaching. It must feel objective, precise, and professional. It relies heavily on structure, typography, and contrast rather than decorative elements.

rules: Never use pure black (#000000) or pure gray (#808080). Use zinc scale for a subtle blue/cool tint.
Primary CTA buttons must use the blue accent color.
Use subtle accent colors (e.g., success_subtle) for sentiment chips, risk level badges, and status indicators.
DO NOT use Inter or standard Sans for headings.
Headings must have tight letter spacing (tracking-tight).
Use font-medium or font-semibold for data labels to improve scanability.

layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Tailwind standard (p-4, p-6, p-8). Generous padding inside cards (p-6).

structure.cards: bg-white border border-zinc-200 rounded-lg shadow-sm overflow-hidden

rules: Use h-full on grid children to stretch and match heights.
Avoid heavy drop shadows; rely on 1px borders and shadow-sm for definition.

components_strategy.buttons: Flat, rounded-md, high contrast. Apply hover transition (e.g., hover:-translate-y-0.5) and focus rings.
components_strategy.cards: Go mostly cardless inside the main workspace, but use strict border containers with p-6 for widgets.
components_strategy.inputs: Shadcn UI Input and Textarea. Flat with subtle borders, strong focus rings.
components_strategy.badges: Rounded-full px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-semibold. Use subtle accent colors for Sentiment, Risk, and Compliance.
components_strategy.charts: Use Recharts or Shadcn Charts. Keep axes clean, use solid colors (Blue, Green, Amber, Red).

libraries.icons: @phosphor-icons/react (Weight: regular or bold for active states)
libraries.animations: framer-motion (for list staggering and card entrance)

motion_and_interactions.hover: Button hover should subtly darken bg (e.g., hover:bg-zinc-100 for ghosts, hover:bg-blue-700 for primary).
motion_and_interactions.entrance: Staggered fade-in-up for dashboard widgets and history lists.
motion_and_interactions.transitions: transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out for interactive elements.

image_urls.description: Professional female agent portrait for user profile or history list

media_and_assets.rules: DO NOT use placeholders. If an image is needed for a user profile, use one of the provided URLs.

accessibility_and_testing.data_testids: MUST include descriptive `data-testid` attributes on all buttons, form inputs, links, and major layout sections (e.g., `data-testid='qa-score-display'`, `data-testid='analyze-call-button'`).
accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure all text, especially within colored badges, meets WCAG AA contrast standards.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install `@fontsource/cabinet-grotesk` and `@fontsource/ibm-plex-sans` and configure them in tailwind.config.js.
Implement the UI using Shadcn components where applicable (Cards, Buttons, Inputs, Badges, Progress bars).
Include a Transcript Input Area (Textarea + Upload button).
Display the Main QA Score prominently (e.g., large circular gauge or large typography card).
Show Sub-scores using Progress bars (Shadcn Progress component).
Render AI Coaching, Root Cause, and Manager Insights in structured, easy-to-read cards.
